fut__open_interest__mtf-none__strike-non.description: Total open interest in perpetual futures contracts representing outstanding positions not yet settled.

fut__oi_change__mtf-none__strike-none__m.description: Absolute change in open interest versus the prior snapshot, indicating position opening or closing.

fut__oi_velocity__mtf-none__strike-none_.description: Rate of change of open interest over time capturing speed of leverage build-up or unwinding.

fut__oi_acceleration__mtf-none__strike-n.description: Second derivative of open interest indicating acceleration or deceleration of position building.

fut__oi_zscore__mtf-none__strike-none__m.description: Z-score of open interest relative to a rolling baseline, normalizing leverage across regimes.

fut__oi_price_divergence__mtf-none__stri.description: Directional divergence between open interest change and price movement computed as sign(oi_change) minus sign(price_return).

fut__oi_price_divergence_strength__mtf-n.description: Magnitude of divergence between open interest and price movement normalized by their rolling volatility.

fut__oi_turnover__mtf-none__strike-none_.description: Ratio of traded volume to open interest indicating how actively positions are rotating.

fut__oi_open_close_ratio__mtf-none__stri.description: Ratio of newly opened contracts to closed contracts indicating net leverage expansion or contraction.
